core: Cytosolic dsRNA sensing and type I interferon induction
name: IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction by cytosolic dsRNA
rationale: All members cover dsRNA/RIG-I/MDA5 sensing feeding IRF3-driven type I IFN induction and its positive regulation, whereas confusables carry negative RLR regulators, NF-kB branches or DNA sensing instead.

core: Contact activation coagulation and von Willebrand factor function
name: Contact activation coagulation and von Willebrand factor variants
rationale: Members are FXII/kallikrein contact activation (including hereditary angioedema and amyloid-triggered FXII) and VWF variant binding/cleavage defects, which distinguish it from confusables centred on the extrinsic/common cascade, fibrin formation and F8/F9 defects.

core: Pyruvate and TCA cycle intermediate metabolism
qualifier: with di- and tricarboxylate membrane transport
name: Pyruvate and TCA-cycle carboxylate metabolism and transport
rationale: Members span pyruvate oxidation to acetyl-CoA, TCA/malate-oxaloacetate metabolism and the SLC transport of pyruvate, succinate and tricarboxylates, combining the metabolism that transporter-only confusables lack with the transport that TCA-only confusables lack.

name: Netrin and DSCAM/sidekick neurite guidance and self-avoidance
rationale: Members combine netrin signalling and axon extension with DSCAM/SDK homophilic interactions and dendrite self-avoidance, the latter absent from the axon-repulsion, ephrin and L1 confusables.

name: Regulation of H2O2- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Every member regulates intrinsic apoptosis or programmed death triggered by hydrogen peroxide/oxidative stress or hypoxia, unlike confusables on MOMP/cytochrome c, respiration control or general ROS responses.

name: Thymic T cell development and selection
rationale: Members cover thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis, migration and positive/negative selection with self-tolerance, distinguishing it from bone-marrow/B-lineage and peripheral T cell activation confusables.

core: Inflammatory mediator G protein-coupled receptor signaling
name: Histamine, purinergic and eicosanoid GPCR signaling
rationale: Members are GPCR responses to histamine, extracellular ATP/P2Y, leukotrienes and prostanoids, and the histamine and purinergic arms separate it from eicosanoid-synthesis confusables.

name: Maternal mRNA clearance at maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members are M-decay, Z-decay, deadenylation and the MZT itself, i.e. deadenylation-driven maternal transcript clearance, unlike general mRNA decay/processing confusables or MZT chromatin confusables.

name: B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin signatures
rationale: Members are B cell and plasma cell/immunoglobulin modules plus plasma cell differentiation, which the germinal centre, memory and naive B cell confusables lack.

core: Fc receptor regulation of antibody effector responses
qualifier: acute inflammation, ADCC and type II hypersensitivity
name: Fc receptor control of antibody-mediated inflammation and cytotoxicity
rationale: Members concern stimulatory/inhibitory Fc receptor signalling governing antibody-driven acute inflammation, ADCC, type II hypersensitivity and phagocytosis, distinct from confusables centred on FCGR phagocytic machinery, BCR inhibition or neutrophil degranulation.

qualifier: TGFBR2, SMAD MH2 domain and TCF7L2
name: TGFBR2, SMAD MH2-domain and TCF7L2 cancer mutants
rationale: All members are cancer mutant forms of TGF-beta pathway (TGFBR2, SMAD2/3/4 MH2) or TCF7L2 effectors, distinguished from TGFBR1/phospho-motif mutant, mismatch repair and wild-type TGF-beta confusables.

name: Small RNA biogenesis and silencing, with splicing repression
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA/lncRNA silencing together with negative regulation of splicing and mRNA processing, the latter separating it from RBP-mediated mRNA decay and target-specific miRNA confusables.

qualifier: NGF processing, NF-kB survival and NRIF death
name: p75 neurotrophin receptor signaling and NGF processing
rationale: Members are p75NTR ligand binding, proteolysis and survival/death outputs plus NGF/neurotrophin production, unlike TRKA confusables and the axon-regeneration/ceramide p75 confusable.

name: Dolichyl-phosphate and GPI anchor biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover dolichyl-phosphate/dolichol-oligosaccharide synthesis and GPI anchor synthesis and attachment, unlike confusables on GDP-mannose CDGs, glycosphingolipids or UDP-GlcNAc/sialic acid.

qualifier: collagen/VWF adhesion receptors and agonist receptors
name: Platelet adhesion, activation and aggregation signaling
rationale: Members span platelet adhesion via GPVI and GPIb-IX-V/VWF, agonist signalling (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin) and degranulation, distinguishing it from G12/13-Rho confusables and coagulation-factor-defect confusables.

qualifier: transferrin and heme uptake and transport
name: Iron and heme uptake, transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover iron import/export disorders, transferrin cycling and heme scavenging/transport, separating it from copper/manganese, heme biosynthesis and scavenger receptor confusables.

name: Regulation of miRNA transcription and processing
rationale: All members regulate miRNA transcription, primary/precursor processing or metabolism, unlike confusables on miRNA silencing effects, target-directed miRNA decay or TGF-beta signalling.

name: Inflammatory monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation and activation
rationale: Members concern monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis regulation, extravasation, activation and inflammatory mediators (CCR2/CX3CR1 modules), versus confusables on endothelial adhesion, monocyte surface identity or chemokine-receptor binding.

name: MITF-M regulation of non-pigmentation target genes
rationale: Every member is MITF-M regulation or its targets for proliferation, DNA repair, invasion, metabolism and lysosomes, while confusables hold the pigmentation/melanin arm or other transcriptional regulators.

name: Oxidative xenobiotic and alkaloid catabolism
rationale: Members are oxidative (CYP-type demethylation/N-dealkylation) breakdown of xenobiotics and alkaloids, distinct from conjugation (sulfonation, acetylation, methylation) and FMO confusables.

qualifier: basal body docking and cilium disassembly
name: Centriole and primary cilium assembly/disassembly regulation
rationale: Members regulate centriole duplication/elongation, basal body anchoring and primary cilium assembly and disassembly, unlike confusables on mitotic spindle/centrosome, intraflagellar transport or MTOC anchoring.

name: Glycolysis to lactate and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation
rationale: Most members describe glucose catabolism through glycolysis to lactate with fructose-2,6-/1,6-bisphosphate control (oxygen transport and resveratrol response are outliers), and the fermentation and F2,6BP arm distinguish it from creatine/oxygen, gluconeogenesis and pentose-shunt confusables.

core: Viral evasion of host immune recognition
name: HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation of host immune receptors
rationale: Members are Nef/Vpu-driven removal of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC class I via host ubiquitin-proteasome machinery, distinct from HIV replication, MHC-I presentation and PD-L1 degradation confusables.

qualifier: inhibition of catecholamine and insulin secretion
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of adenylate cyclase and secretion
rationale: Members are alpha-2 adrenergic/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition and its suppression of epinephrine, norepinephrine and insulin secretion, the secretory arm absent from generic cAMP and adrenoceptor confusables.

name: Regulation of NF-kappaB activity by SUMOylation and deubiquitination
rationale: Members regulate (mostly restrain) canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity, with SUMOylation and deubiquitination distinguishing it from TNFR/NIK/TLR activation confusables and the generic DUB confusable.
